label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: EMC is explicitly named in the other-sarcoma monotherapy eligibility list. The trial-level scope is compatible through cohort F, not through every cohort.
cohort_reconciliation: A/B phase I advanced STS monotherapy shares A/B/E/F eligibility including EMC; E is specifically limited to named liposarcoma subtypes or leiomyosarcoma.
F phase II other advanced sarcomas explicitly includes EMC.
C phase I admits advanced STS/other solid tumors subject to radiation suitability; C phase II uses a closed list lacking EMC, reinforced by exclusion of other histologies.
D localized intermediate-risk STS requires one of a closed list lacking EMC and excludes other subtypes.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No additional tumor molecular gate stated; central pathology and tumor samples required.
protocol_uncertainty: Full external protocol not reviewed. Which cohort/phase remains open is unverified; the old status verification month and estimated completion dates cannot establish live slots. Prior chemotherapy exceptions and radiation suitability require protocol/investigator assessment.
quotes: Histologies other than those described in the inclusion criteria.
A centralized diagnosis of DD liposarcoma or mixoid/hypercellular liposarcoma or leiomyosarcoma must be confirmed for patients in cohort E.

label: explicit_exclusion
rationale: The required cancer is endometrial cancer, with sarcoma expressly excluded; the summary's EMC abbreviation refers to endometrial cancer.
cohort_reconciliation: Experimental fruquintinib/sintilimab and chemotherapy control share the same advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer entry criteria; no sarcoma basket is described.
extra_biomarker_requirement: Non-MSI-H or pMMR and biomarker sample required for this endometrial study; not evidence of any EMC biomarker.
protocol_uncertainty: Full external protocol not reviewed; saved disease restriction is explicit despite remaining patient-level criteria.
quotes: Histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer with measurable lesions

label: explicit_exclusion
rationale: All substudies require histologically confirmed stage I-III endometrial carcinoma; a list of carcinoma subtypes including carcinosarcoma does not admit extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma.
cohort_reconciliation: RAINBO BLUE A1 observation and A2 observation/radiotherapy concern POLE-mutated endometrial cancer; TAPER observation/brachytherapy concerns p53wt/NSMP endometrial cancer. None creates an open solid-tumor arm.
extra_biomarker_requirement: POLE-mutated or p53wt/NSMP substudies; alteration status unestablished and does not override histology.
protocol_uncertainty: Detailed molecular subgroup allocation is not fully stated in saved eligibility; external protocol unreviewed. The endometrial carcinoma restriction itself is clear.
quotes: Patients must have histologically confirmed Stage I to III endometrial carcinoma which can be endometrioid, serous, clear cell, un/dedifferentiated, carcinosarcoma or mixed.

label: explicit_exclusion
rationale: Required prostate adenocarcinoma is incompatible with EMC disease scope; the investigational EZH2 drug does not create a molecularly open basket.
cohort_reconciliation: Both mevrometostat/enzalutamide and placebo/enzalutamide arms share metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer entry; no other disease cohort.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No EMC-defining fusion route stated; prostate disease and prior-treatment requirements remain specific to this protocol.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol unreviewed; prior systemic treatment exceptions require investigator assessment but do not broaden histology.
quotes: Histologically or cytologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the prostate without small cell features.
